segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports occasional bumps when overusing the product on the face, but no breakouts on areas used sparingly, and another says it did not make her skin oily.
segments.dry: Several reviewers with dry skin report the product did not further dry or flake their skin and left it smooth and moisturized, though one noted a few tiny dry patches on first use and another advises not to skip a moisturizer after application since it can be drying.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report softer, more radiant skin and smoother forehead lines without irritation, and improved elasticity with continued use.
segments.sensitive: Many reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or reactive/acne-prone sensitive skin, report no irritation, redness, or peeling and describe the product as gentle; a couple mention minor tingling on first use or slight dry patches initially.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as mature (40s-50s) report firmer, lifted-looking skin, softened jawline sagging, and reduced neck wrinkles after several weeks of use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines, improved firmness, and a lifted look on the face, jawline, and neck within two to four weeks; a few long-term retinoid/tretinoin users or those with only mild wrinkles saw little to no change.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dehydrated or dry skin report the product hydrates without greasiness and does not worsen dryness; one noted needing extra moisturizer afterward to avoid tightness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer noted redness during the first week that resolved with continued use; others with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin report no increase in redness at all.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers say the product did not damage or compromise their skin barrier the way other retinols had, with one specifically noting it restored the skin's natural barrier.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers with hyperpigmentation or age/sun spots report fading or improvement after weeks of use; this is mentioned by a minority rather than most reviewers.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin report no new breakouts; one reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin describes occasional bumps appearing the day after applying more product than usual to the face.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the product does not make skin oily; oiliness is otherwise rarely discussed.

aspects.libelle: Creamy, thick texture that absorbs well

extraits.texte: I like several Murad products, but this one after two months has not shown me it was worth the cost. Very strong perfume scent, only a serviceable moisturizer with little in the way of resurfacing, a bit irritating with the fragrance. I will not buy again.
